findings.desc: [packages/main/src/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.ts:343] validate hint coverage only stubs decorateResult with injected activeStory, so it does not exercise the real `koala validate --json` CLI path. In this REVIEW worktree, a fresh `koala validate --json` still ended with `→ 验证全绿。下一步：story_advance --storyId=B-e61b --phase=DONE`, which contradicts the expected REVIEW->TEST routing and the recorded verificationEvidence. This leaves CHK-001/CHK-003 validate-hint evidence insufficient and allows wrong gate guidance to escape.

[MEDIUM] packages/main/src/handlers/hints.ts:145 - bugUpdateHint still tells TEST-stage users to run story_advance --phase=DONE as soon as the last bug is fixed. That bypasses the new DONE pre-check guidance introduced in this story, so warning/blocking rows like delivery-check, summary, or dirty tree can still exist while the hint points straight at DONE. Align this path with the phase-aware validate/session guidance and send users to inspect DONE pre-check before advancing.

packages/main/src/handlers/hints.ts:215 local worktree CLI correctly hints REVIEW -> TEST, but the shipped global koala command still prints REVIEW -> DONE for `koala validate --channel --story=B-e61b --json`; this environment difference is not surfaced and can mislead end users about the real next step.
